verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing pages document per-plan monthly search quotas, such as 250 searches/month on the free tier and 1,000,000 on Cloud 1M. They also describe a self-serve path: start free, upgrade as you grow, month-to-month billing, and Automatic Early Renewal when searches run out. The Cloud 1M row shows a second figure (110,000), but its column is unlabeled in the evidence, so it cannot be confirmed as an hourly or throughput limit. missing for 10: explicitly documented per-hour/per-second rate limits, documented concurrency caps, behavior when limits are hit (e.g., 429 handling), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and concurrency caps with a self-serve upgrade path

citations.quote: Start for free, upgrade as you grow, or contact our team about an enterprise plan tailored to your volume, performance, and compliance needs.
You can set your plan to Automatic Early Renewal. It will trigger an early renewal once you've used all your searches.
